mapper.sql: id, publication_id, tenant_company_id, user_id, product_type, plan, status, start_time, end_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mp_subscription (publication_id, tenant_company_id, user_id, product_type, plan, status, start_time, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{publicationId}, #{tenantCompanyId}, #{userId}, COALESCE(#{productType}, 'AGENT'), COALESCE(#{plan}, 'FREE'), COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{startTime}, NOW(3)), #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mp_subscription WHERE publication_id = #{publicationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.tenant_company_id) FROM mp_subscription s JOIN mp_publication p ON p.id = s.publication_id WHERE p.author_id = #{authorId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted = 0
SELECT FROM mp_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY start_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM mp_subscription WHERE tenant_company_id = #{tenantCompanyId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY start_time DESC, id DESC
